summary: Zheng et al. map the infiltrating T-cell compartment of hepatocellular carcinoma with deep single-cell RNA-seq, resolving subset structure and trajectories rather than treating TILs as a single pool. The atlas links exhausted and regulatory states to the tumor niche and nominates LAYN as a functionally relevant marker on immunosuppressive T cells.
key_claims: 5,063 T cells from blood, tumor, and adjacent liver of six HCC patients were profiled by scRNA-seq.
Eleven T-cell subsets were defined using transcriptional programs plus assembled TCR sequences.
Exhausted CD8+ T cells and Tregs are preferentially enriched and potentially clonally expanded in HCC.
Layilin (LAYN) is upregulated on activated CD8+ T cells and Tregs and can repress CD8+ function in vitro.
